title: BotRoutineDocumentSnapshot v1
description: The data object of a durable routine.defined / routine.updated / routine.deleted event, frozen from Sources/PhoneDSHBot/Routines/{DurableSnapshot,RoutineStore,RoutineModels}.swift: {botId, document:{version, routines, deliveries}}. The routines array items are validated against routine.schema.json and each deliveries value against routine-delivery.schema.json; the shared checker performs both nested checks because the repository's JSON-Schema subset does not resolve $ref. See spec/bot/v2/README.md §2.2.
